sources.title: Organoid Modeling of the Tumor Immune Microenvironment.
sources.scope: Defined immune-preserving model capabilities; no universal clinical prediction claim.

sources.title: A most stubborn bias: no adjustment method fully resolves confounding by indication in observational studies.
sources.scope: Treatment-selection confounding and limits of adjustment in this study; not a claim that every adjustment method always fails.

sources.title: Transparent reporting of a multivariable prediction model for individual prognosis or diagnosis (TRIPOD): the TRIPOD statement.
sources.scope: Original TRIPOD statement defines internal and external model validation; transparent reporting is not certification.

sources.title: Integrated digital error suppression for improved detection of circulating tumor DNA.
sources.scope: Molecular recovery and background error suppression in a defined workflow; no universal detection limit.

sources.title: Computational correction of copy number effect improves specificity of CRISPR-Cas9 essentiality screens in cancer cells.
sources.evidenceType: Primary computational method evaluated on screens
sources.scope: CERES models copy-number effects; correction does not certify a drug mechanism.

sources.title: An unbiased metric of antiproliferative drug effect in vitro.
sources.scope: DIP rate addresses timing of antiproliferative measurements; endpoint viability does not inherently mean cell death.

sources.title: Growth rate inhibition metrics correct for confounders in measuring sensitivity to cancer drugs.
sources.scope: Cell-division rate affects conventional drug-response metrics; GR measures remain experimental readouts.

sources.title: High-intensity sequencing reveals the sources of plasma circulating cell-free DNA variants.
sources.evidenceType: Matched plasma, white-blood-cell and tumor sequencing
sources.scope: Somatic plasma variants may originate in blood cells; gene identity alone does not establish origin.

sources.title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan in metastatic breast cancer with variable HER2 expression: the phase 2 DAISY trial.
sources.scope: DAISY expression cohorts are exploratory clinical evidence, without a randomized comparison or universal cutoff.

sources.title: Circulating Tumor DNA Analysis Guiding Adjuvant Therapy in Stage II Colon Cancer.
sources.scope: DYNAMIC stage II colon cancer example used for design only; no numerical efficacy claim or extension to every MRD assay.

sources.title: Immortal time bias in pharmaco-epidemiology.
sources.evidenceType: Primary methodological analysis with lung cancer illustration
sources.scope: Exposure classification and survival time alignment can create bias.

sources.title: Using Big Data to Emulate a Target Trial When a Randomized Trial Is Not Available.
sources.scope: Read abstract; no numerical extraction.

sources.title: A framework to rank genomic alterations as targets for cancer precision medicine: the ESMO Scale for Clinical Actionability of molecular Targets (ESCAT).
sources.scope: ESCAT ranks target evidence; evidence tier does not establish individual access or eligibility.

sources.title: Competing risks in epidemiology: possibilities and pitfalls.
sources.scope: Cause-specific hazards and cumulative incidence answer different questions; not a treatment efficacy trial.

sources.title: Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC): a resource for therapeutic biomarker discovery in cancer cells.
sources.scope: Existing GDSC citation retained; original abstract rechecked without copying historical dataset counts into a current record.

sources.title: The use of propensity scores to assess the generalizability of results from randomized trials.
sources.scope: Participation propensity approach with a school-prevention worked example; not validated oncology matching.

sources.title: Monitoring drug target engagement in cells and tissues using the cellular thermal shift assay.
sources.scope: CETSA measures drug-associated thermal stability as engagement evidence; engagement alone is not dependency or clinical benefit.

sources.title: Detection of circulating tumor DNA in early- and late-stage human malignancies.
sources.scope: ctDNA detectability varies by disease context; no universal negative-test exclusion rule.

sources.title: Off-target toxicity is a common mechanism of action of cancer drugs undergoing clinical trials.
sources.scope: Selected compounds retained activity after proposed target loss; no blanket estimate for all cancer drugs copied.

sources.title: SLC46A3 Is Required to Transport Catabolites of Noncleavable Antibody Maytansine Conjugates from the Lysosome to the Cytoplasm.
sources.scope: SLC46A3 dependence is specific to the tested noncleavable maytansine species; the tested MMAF constructs differed.

sources.title: Improved Tumor Penetration and Single-Cell Targeting of Antibody-Drug Conjugates Increases Anticancer Efficacy and Host Survival.
sources.scope: Coadministration altered intratumoral distribution and efficacy in that model; no human dosing recommendation.

sources.title: Clinically Relevant Concentrations of Anticancer Drugs: A Guide for Nonclinical Studies.
sources.evidenceType: Clinical PK compilation from labels and publications
sources.scope: Nonclinical exposure comparison must consider measured species, protein binding and timing; no numerical dosing guidance.

sources.title: Genomic Copy Number Dictates a Gene-Independent Cell Response to CRISPR/Cas9 Targeting.
sources.scope: DNA cutting in amplified regions can cause gene-independent antiproliferative effects.

sources.title: Decision curve analysis: a novel method for evaluating prediction models.
sources.scope: Net benefit weighs decision consequences under assumptions; not a clinical impact trial.

sources.title: Recommendations for application of the functional evidence PS3/BS3 criterion using the ACMG/AMP sequence variant interpretation framework.
sources.scope: PS3/BS3 functional sequence-variant interpretation, not a somatic cancer-drug actionability rule.

sources.title: Biomarker: Predictive or Prognostic?
sources.scope: Predictive evidence requires comparison of treatment effects and a biomarker interaction; not merely response association.

sources.title: Determination of Cellular Processing Rates for a Trastuzumab-Maytansinoid Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) Highlights Key Parameters for ADC Design.
sources.scope: Binding, uptake, degradation and payload movement are distinct processes in the studied trastuzumab-maytansinoid system.

sources.title: Cutoff Finder: a comprehensive and straightforward Web application enabling rapid biomarker cutoff optimization.
sources.evidenceType: Primary software-method study with breast cancer examples
sources.scope: Optimization is discovery; full-text discussion separates cutoff selection from predefined-cutoff validation.

sources.title: A simple high-content cell cycle assay reveals frequent discrepancies between cell number and ATP and MTS proliferation assays.
sources.scope: Cell counts and ATP/MTS readouts can diverge with drug mechanism and cell state.

sources.title: Partly nonparametric approach for determining the limit of detection.
sources.scope: Detection-limit estimation depends on errors and background; not clinical sensitivity or a product certificate.

sources.title: Comparison of tumor-informed and tumor-naïve sequencing assays for ctDNA detection in breast cancer.
sources.scope: Tumor-informed and tumor-naive breast cancer assays differed under tested conditions; no ranking of all commercial assays.

sources.title: Replication of null results: Absence of evidence or evidence of absence?
sources.evidenceType: Primary methodological analysis of replication projects
sources.scope: Includes cancer biology; nonsignificance is distinct from evidence of equivalence or absence.
